did: Home now writes each week's engagement report itself and turns it into a video. A day after a week ends, home reads its own records for that week and keeps them once, then hands them to the render worker. The render worker writes the report by code and records it with home's speaker. The phone can fetch the video, record its YouTube link and let it go, as it does the call's. Two fresh reviews, plus Codex, found that a week missed while home was down would be lost for good, that a deleted account's logs would stay on the drive, and that the lane couldn't see a report render; all three are fixed.

calls.title: A week's report is kept in its own table, with the file on the drive as its copy
options: a table, the drive file its copy
no record, read the week again
calls.why: The table leaves with the account and survives a lost drive, and a week let go is never rendered again; the file alone outlives the account.
calls.undo: Drop report_week and write the weekly read straight to the drive (C570).

calls.title: A week is written a day after it ends
calls.why: Records the phone sends on its next open after Sunday evening still make it, and the video comes the next day.

calls.title: Each pass also asks the three weeks before the last that home doesn't hold
options: every week since the first record
calls.why: A week home was down for is still written once it's back, and a pass stays at four reads.

calls.title: The report's video is a new feed with its own two tables
options: a new feed over its own tables
one video table shared by template
calls.why: It is how every feed since the call was added, and it leaves the call's records as they are.
calls.undo: Remove the report feed and its tables (C572).

left: The phone's Calls screen offering the report is step 5, for a fresh worker; #821 lists what it needs.
A week the recorder always refuses can't be let go, because let-go needs a video; every render job is the same, so it's the owner's call (server#981).
No real week has rendered on home yet; the first deploy will likely fire ReportRenderOverdue for up to four kept weeks until the lane renders them.
